# Philippines journal preparation — 23 October 2026

## Owner request and scope

Translate the supplied Dutch Philippines account into English, edit it in the existing journal voice without losing the personal story, include all supplied media in the existing chapter slideshow presentation, add useful place links and source-checked “Did you know?” facts. Prepare for review; no current production publication or email request.

The owner confirmed that the village drone photograph belongs to Oslob, the underwater photographs to Boracay, and the September church/street photographs to Manila. The cancelled destination is Moalboal. The arm-wrestling film belongs to the Oslob hostel.

## Implementation

- Replaced the preview with eight reading chapters and the existing article reader, chapter navigation, progress and cinematic mode.
- All 40 unique photographs in the supplied Philippines media folder appear once each across six manual chapter slideshows: Oslob 3, Bohol 4, Boracay 8, El Nido 14, weather/canopy walk 5, Manila 6. The masthead reuses an El Nido photograph.

- Prepared three responsive WebP sizes per photograph, preserving framing and orientation. Fresh pixel derivatives contain no EXIF/XMP metadata. Original photographs remain outside the website source and are unchanged.

Playback starts muted, stays viewport-aware, and uses the existing reduced-motion/manual-start behaviour. No new playback code or dependency was added to the website.
- Retained the existing whale-shark film and El Nido tour film, and the existing #story and #el-nido destinations. Existing road-film links remain.
- Added eleven compact fact cards with nearby source hyperlinks, plus the owner-supplied venue links and Google Maps searches. Kept personal estimates and opinions distinct from sourced facts; corrected the Panglao/Bohol and language descriptions.
- Updated the shared destination/story records, Stories listing, old Bali preview link, derived Field Note/search projections and Philippines metadata. Stable story/note IDs and routes remain. No publication date was invented.
- No new service, billing, Auth/Rules change, upcoming trip reveal, mail automation or subscriber campaign.

## Sources used

- Philippine Embassy in The Hague: archipelago/island groups — https://thehaguepe.dfa.gov.ph/index.php/2014-03-12-01-20-59/2014-03-12-01-57-04

- Primary Oslob encounter study — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4671167/
- Bohol Provincial Tourism Office: Panglao/bridges/Bilar forest — https://tourism.bohol.gov.ph/2023/04/04/exploring-bohol-island-a-gem-in-visayas-philippines/
- UNESCO Tentative List description: Chocolate Hills, natural formation and seasonal colour — https://whc.unesco.org/en/tentativelists/5024/
- UNESCO: Bohol Global Geopark — https://www.unesco.org/en/iggp/geoparks/bohol-island
- Department of Tourism: Boracay/White Beach — https://remote.tourism.gov.ph/tourism/doing-business/
- DENR Biodiversity Management Bureau: El Nido protected area — https://pais.bmb.gov.ph/home/info/DENRR4B0007
- PAGASA: cyclone frequency/season — https://bagong.pagasa.dost.gov.ph/climate/tropical-cyclone-information
- Intramuros Administration: fort/gate history and Rizal — https://intramuros.gov.ph/2022/02/22/preparatory-study-of-fort-santiago-seal-and-details-1983/ and https://intramuros.gov.ph/mnr/

- 1987 Constitution, Article XIV; 1937 national-language order — https://officialgazette.gov.ph/constitutions/1987-constitution/ and https://lawphil.net/executive/execord/eo1937/eo_134_1937.html
